findings.title: On product pages the Shipping & Returns tab says orders ship "within 5-10 business days", while the Shipping page promises delivery in "2-4 business days"
see_it: Open https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/products/helix-denim and open the "Shipping & Returns" tab under the description: "Free shipping and returns available on all orders! We ship all US domestic orders within 5-10 business days!"
Scroll a little further on the same page to "Free Shipping": "You'll receive your order an estimated 1–4 days after shipment."

In the footer click "Shipping policy" (/pages/shipping): "Delivery takes between 2-4 business days depending on your location" and "Please allow 2 business days to receive your shipment notification email after placing your order."

evidence.note: live 2026-10-11, Helix page: Shipping & Returns tab text and the Free Shipping block text
live, Louise Slide Sandal page: same Shipping & Returns tab text
lines 6-7: the same text as the tab, on /pages/shipping-returns
"You'll receive your order an estimated 1–4 days after shipment."
line 12: "We ship worldwide", "2-4 business days", "allow 2 business days to receive your shipment notification"

findings.why_it_matters: A buyer reading the product page and the footer's shipping page cannot tell whether the order leaves within 2 business days or takes up to 10, so cannot work out when it will arrive. Mixed promises lead to "where is my order?" contacts and disputes when the shorter promise is missed. The tab also speaks of "US domestic orders" while the store prices in CAD and the shipping page says "We ship worldwide".

fix.summary: Pick one dispatch time and one delivery window per region and use the same words in the product-page tab, the Free Shipping block and the Shipping page.
steps: Decide the real dispatch (handling) time and transit time per region

Edit the text behind the product page's "Shipping & Returns" tab (it matches /pages/shipping-returns word for word, so the tab probably shows that page) and the "Free Shipping" block in the product template
Update /pages/shipping to the same numbers, stating dispatch and delivery separately (for example: dispatched within X business days, delivered Y to Z business days later)
fix.where_to_change: Online Store > Pages > Shipping & Returns and Shipping; Online Store > Themes > Customize > Product page (Shipping & Returns tab, Free Shipping block)

I will give you the real dispatch and transit times per region. Draft one consistent wording for each of the three places, then list exactly which page or theme block holds each text. Constraints: edit pages as drafts and theme blocks on a duplicate, unpublished theme; never touch checkout; show me the before and after text before publishing. Check: open a product page, its Shipping & Returns tab and /pages/shipping, and confirm every timing matches.
findings.verify_fix: Open a product page, open the Shipping & Returns tab, read the Free Shipping block, then open the footer's Shipping policy page: dispatch and delivery times match in all three.
